title: An Unexpected Comedy
next_chapter_hook: Han Lie fled in humiliation with his stomped face, vowing to take Chen Ji's life next time. Yet what he didn't know was that Chen Ji had already left a tracking mark on his back—the true winner of this farce had always been watching coldly from outside the chessboard.

text.content: In a secluded valley hidden by dense forest at the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain, Chen Ji leaned against a blue stone, holding a half-cup of cold tea, his brow showing rare traces of leisure. The words of the imperial envoy still echoed—the final task his father left behind actually involved the imperial court? This game was bigger than he imagined. Yet for now, he only wanted to enjoy this rare moment of peace. Birds chirped in the distance, Chen Ji's brow slightly furrowed, but he showed no intention of getting up to check. Hmph, there are always people who like to disturb others' tranquility.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji! Get your sorry ass out here!

text.content: A thunderous roar shattered the valley's tranquility. Chen Ji's cold tea trembled slightly, yet he didn't even lift his eyelids. Han Lie? Arrived quite fast. He'd deliberately shown his whereabouts in front of Han Lie these past few days, just to lure this mad dog onto the hook—only he hadn't expected this mad dog to be even more impatient than anticipated. Between the swaying shadows, a robust figure burst through the forest, Han Lie with murderous intent written across his face.

dialogue.content: You worthless trash! The account from the scripture repository last time, today you'll repay with your life!

text.content: Chen Ji slowly set down his teacup, about to say something, when a cold laugh came from another direction: "Oh? What wild dog is barking here?" Ye Qing had somehow appeared three zhang away, demonic energy flickering around her. She glanced at Han Lie, lips curling in mockery: "When did Tianqing Sect territory become a place for Xuanwu Sect dogs to run wild?"

Han Lie's pupils constricted sharply, then burst into wild laughter: "Good! Excellent! The trash found a demonic path witch as a helper, today I'll send this dog and bitch to the afterlife together!" Before his words finished, his玄气 surged, and his iron fists already carried howling wind as they smashed toward Ye Qing. Ye Qing冷笑一声, her form化作一道黑雾, easily dodging this clumsy strike: "That's it? Xuanwu Sect's number one genius? Heh, just a brainless brute."

choice.prompt: Seeing Ye Qing and Han Lie about to truly clash, Chen Ji had to make a choice—

choices.text: Pour oil on the fire, make the situation even more chaotic
choices.description: Seize the chaos to give Han Lie another knife, let him and Ye Qing wear each other down, reap the渔翁之利.
choices.visible_cost: Drain Han Lie's hatred toward himself
choices.visible_reward: Weaken Han Lie's strength, while also making Ye Qing owe him a favor
choices.risk_hint: May expose the alliance with Ye Qing

dialogue.content: (Pretend to panic and retreat, secretly leaving a restriction at Han Lie's landing spot) Ah! Please don't fight, it's all a misunderstanding!

text.content: Chen Ji's panicked appearance, as seen by Han Lie, only made the latter more triumphant—this trash truly only knows how to hide behind women. Yet Han Lie didn't know that every step he took was within Chen Ji's calculations. The instant the restriction silently activated, the ground beneath Han Lie's feet suddenly sank half an cun, his offensive momentum instantly stalled. In combat between experts, one instant determines life and death. Ye Qing's demonic energy seized the opportunity without hesitation, slapping Han Lie on the shoulder.

choices.text: Resolve the misunderstanding, play the pig to eat the tiger
choices.description: Continue playing weak, use cunning words to resolve this conflict peacefully, while signaling Ye Qing to cooperate.
choices.visible_cost: Requires energy expenditure to maintain the lie
choices.visible_reward: Maintain the废物 persona, Han Lie continues to underestimate himself
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing's proud personality may not cooperate

dialogue.content: Han Shixiong, you're mistaken! This lady is just a passing traveler, we're not acquainted at all!

text.content: Ye Qing raised an eyebrow, about to retort, but caught Chen Ji winking at her secretly. Her mind quickly turned,冷哼一声收回魔气: "A废物而已，本座还不屑与他为伍。倒是你这蛮牛，本座今日心情好，饶你一命。" Han Lie愣了愣,随即狂笑起来: "听见没有?废物!连魔道妖女都看不上你!"

choices.text: Secretly mark, wait for the right moment
choices.description: Don't directly intervene in the conflict, secretly leave a tracking mark on Han Lie during the chaos, then retreat safely, let Ye Qing hold him off.
choices.visible_cost: Requires Ye Qing's cooperation to act
choices.visible_reward: Gain the ability to track Han Lie, can know his whereabouts anytime in the future
choices.risk_hint: May be in danger if caught by Han Lie

dialogue.content: (Silently take out a talisman from his sleeve, while Han Lie punches furiously, strike the tracking mark into his back) You two fight slowly, Chen will take his leave first!

text.content: Ye Qing understood his intention perfectly, her demonic energy suddenly surging by thirty percent, blocking Han Lie's line of sight by force: "Want to chase him? Ask my demonic fog first." Han Lie roared and tangled with her, unaware that the tracking mark had deeply embedded itself in his body— whenever he wished, Chen Ji could know exactly where this brute was and what he was doing.

Han Lie was knocked stumbling backward by Ye Qing's palm, a hint of astonishment flashing across his face. He clearly hadn't expected the demonic path witch's strength to be this troublesome. "Good! Good one, demonic path witch!" Han Lie gritted his teeth, wiping the blood from his mouth corner, his killing intent even thicker in his eyes, "Today's matter, I'll remember! When my Xuanwu Sect's great army tramples Tianqing Sect—that will be your death day!"

dialogue.content: Han Shixiong is mighty, I admire you immensely! Please go slowly, do visit again!

text.content: Chen Ji hid behind a tree, watching Han Lie's狼狈离去的身影, lips slightly curving upward. That sycophantic voice even made himself nauseous, but the effect was excellent—Han Lie's disdain practically溢出, only seeing him as a tail-wagging dog. Ye Qing收回魔气, gracefully landing beside Chen Ji, looking at him with a half-smile: "Chen Ji, your废物人设, truly a masterful performance."

choice.prompt: Ye Qing gave you a thumbs up, this farce temporarily concluded. But how should we wrap things up next?

choices.text: Invite Ye Qing for tea, naturally discuss matters regarding the imperial court
choices.description: The coincidence just now sparked an inspiration—are there connections between imperial court, father, Han Lie... these clues? As a demonic path saint, Ye Qing has extensive information networks, perhaps she knows something.
choices.visible_reward: Gain intelligence related to the imperial court, deepen alliance with Ye Qing
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing may take the opportunity to probe your trump cards

dialogue.content: Oh? This废物 still hides good tea? Fine, this one will honor it with a taste.

text.content: Chen Ji took out an exquisite tea set from his storage bag, movements flowing like water. Ye Qing slightly raised her brow: "This废物 knows how to enjoy life. Speak, what do you want to know from this one?" Chen Ji poured her a cup: "Has there been any unusual activity from the imperial court lately?" Ye Qing received the teacup, eyes flashing: "Imperial court... you did ask the right question. There have indeed been some interesting tidings recently."

choices.text: Separate, continue investigating imperial court clues
choices.description: Though Ye Qing is a usable ally, her stance is after all in the demonic path. Some things are better investigated alone. You decide to investigate the connection between the imperial court and your father first.
choices.visible_reward: Maintain information blockade, don't let Ye Qing know too much

dialogue.content: So eager to kick this one out? Fine, remember to call me when there's good drama next time.

text.content: Ye Qing冷哼一声, her form dispersed into black fog and vanished. Chen Ji gazed at her departing direction, eyes flickering with complexity. Father's task, imperial court's movements, Han Lie's appearance...这一切似乎都指向同一个方向. He spread his palm open, a wisp of ethereal玄气凝聚 at his fingertips—Han Lie's tracking mark on his back was emitting faint fluctuations. Heh, a brute，终究是 brute.

The valley returned to silence, Chen Ji packed up his tea set, just about to leave, when a white-robed figure emerged from the forest—Su Qingyao held a sword, brow carrying traces of审视. "Chen Ji, what was that commotion just now?" Her gaze swept over the battle traces on the ground, then looked at Chen Ji's intact appearance, brow furrowing deeper, "Han Lie that idiot came to cause trouble again?"

dialogue.content: How could that废物 possibly injure Han Shixiong? It was just his luck to encounter a passing wandering cultivator.

Su Qingyao deeply gazed at him, that目光仿佛要将他看穿: "Is that so? That wandering cultivator who came and went like wind." She paused, suddenly冷笑一声, "Chen Ji, you'd better pray there's nothing hidden on you. Otherwise, if I find out—" Chen Ji displayed a harmless smile: "Su Shimei worries too much, junior brother is merely a servant disciple, what secrets could I possibly have?"

text.content: Su Qingyao冷哼一声, turned to leave, leaving behind profound words: "Let's hope so." Chen Ji watched her departing figure, eyes glinting. This Inner Disciple Senior Fellow's curiosity is far more dangerous than Han Lie that idiot. But at present, he had more important matters. The tracking mark on Han Lie's back was emanating a restless aura—like from the direction of Xuanwu Sect, something had changed. Chen Ji's lips curved into a playful arc: Looks like interesting times are coming.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji! Remember this! Next time we meet, I'll take your life!

text.content: Han Lie's furious roar echoed across the valley. Chen Ji shook his head, this idiot, injured yet still so full of energy, truly Xuanwu Sect's foundations are remarkable. Only he didn't know that while he was spouting threats, the tracking mark Chen Ji left on his back had silently activated— no matter where he fled to the ends of the earth, Chen Ji could precisely lock onto his position. The true winner of this farce had always been watching coldly from outside the chessboard. The imperial court's mystery remains unsolved, father's布局 still shrouded in fog, but Chen Ji had already acquired new pieces. Han Lie, live well for now, wait until I need you.
